tasks.prompt: Create a new part document at {document} and author an open-top electronics enclosure: outer size 50 mm x 30 mm x 15 mm tall, uniform 1.5 mm walls, top face open. Keep the dimensions and wall thickness as named parameters.

Create a new part document at {document} and author an 80 mm x 50 mm x 6 mm mounting plate with two 8 mm diameter through holes, centred 20 mm from each short edge on the plate's long centreline. Keep the plate size, thickness, and hole diameter as named parameters.
The part document at {document} is a bracket plate with a mounting hole. Change it to 100 mm wide and 8 mm thick, keeping its 60 mm height and the hole. The plate must stay rectangular.

Create a new part document at {document} and author a 60 mm x 40 mm x 5 mm plate with one through slot centred on the plate: 30 mm between the centres of its rounded ends and 8 mm wide, running along the plate's long direction. Keep the plate size, slot length, and slot width as named parameters.
Create a new part document at {document} and bring in the purchased part from the STEP file {workdir}/bracket.step as a fixed solid body, unmodified and unmoved.
The part document at {document} is a bracket plate with a mounting hole. Round every edge of its top face, the four outer edges and the rim of the hole, with a 1 mm fillet.

Create a new part document at {document} and author a tapered round boss with a loft: a 40 mm diameter circular base centred on the origin in the XY plane, blending into a 20 mm diameter circle centred 30 mm directly above it.

Create a new part document at {document} and author a solid pipe elbow with a sweep: a 10 mm diameter round section that runs straight up the +Z axis from the origin for 30 mm, then turns through a 90 degree bend of 20 mm centreline radius towards +X.

Create a new part document at {document} with a compression spring: a 2 mm diameter round wire coiled around the Z axis at a 10 mm coil radius (axis to wire centre), 5 mm pitch, over a 20 mm helix height. Drive the wire diameter, coil radius, pitch, and height with parameters named wire_diameter, coil_radius, pitch, and coil_height.

The assembly {document} places two instances of a bracket part, spaced by a distance mate between their origin faces. Add a third instance of the same bracket component and position it with a new 120 mm distance mate from the right bracket's origin face, in the same way as the existing spacing mate. Keep every mate satisfied.

The part document {workdir}/bracket.ocad.d is an 80 mm wide bracket. Create a new drawing document at {document} with one A4 portrait sheet showing the bracket at full scale in a front view and a top view (the drawing references the part by the relative path ../bracket.ocad.d). Add one linear dimension of the bracket's 80 mm overall width on the front view.

The part {workdir}/bracket.ocad.d has already been widened from 80 mm to 100 mm. Create a new A4 portrait drawing at {document}, with a full-scale front view referencing ../bracket.ocad.d and one semantic width dimension bound to its existing ref:edge:bracket_top_front. Do not use fixed point coordinates. Verify the patch, apply it and export {workdir}/drawing.svg. Regenerate the drawing and report its measured width.

The robot assembly at {document} is missing its wrist joint, but the wrist mate is still present. Add a revolute joint named joint:wrist on mate:wrist with limits -90 deg to +90 deg, effort 0.4 N m, and velocity 4 rad/s. Verify and apply the patch, export {workdir}/arm.urdf, then run reach for tool gripper at point 0,40,7mm to target 120,170,63mm and report whether it reaches.

Add a named parametric datum axis to {document}. Its direction is global +Y and its origin is [axis_x, 0, 0] metres, where the new length parameter axis_x = 5 mm. Set the existing revolve to use that datum axis through axis_feature. Keep the original sketch, radius, height and angle parameters unchanged. Verify regeneration; the moved axis must reduce the original 15/25 mm radii to 10/20 mm over the 20 mm height.
Change draft_angle in {document} from 5 deg to 10 deg. Preserve the datum neutral plane, semantic +x face and all plate dimensions. Verify regeneration and the inward-drafted volume.
Change rib_height in {document} from 12 mm to 20 mm. Preserve the sketch centerline, rib_thickness and base plate dimensions. Verify regeneration and the joined rib volume.

Change tap_depth in {document} from 8 mm to 10 mm. Preserve both M6 standard_hole definitions, the explicit tap_drill representation, diameters, clearance hole and plate dimensions. Verify regeneration and the cylindrical volume; no physical thread helix is modeled.

Change end_radius in {document} from 1.5 mm to 2 mm while preserving start_radius = 0.5 mm, the semantic front edge and the explicit linear radius law. Keep the plate dimensions unchanged. Verify regeneration and review the reference provenance. Endpoint order follows increasing X. Compare the rounded volume to the circular-corner reference with the documented OCCT approximation.

Change source_height in {document} from 8 mm to 10 mm. Preserve target_height = 6 mm, both existing extruded bodies, and the body_boolean union with source_feature feature:tool and target_feature feature:plate. Use DesignPatch and verify regeneration. Expected union volume: 31200 mm^3.

In {document}, replace dim:plate_corner with a new semantic angular dimension dim:plate_corner_large on view:front, using the same ref:edge:plate_front and ref:edge:plate_left with both canonical ray ends end, and arc_radius_m = 0.015 (15 mm on the sheet). Preserve the view and model. Use remove_drawing_dimension then add_angular_dimension with the new stable ID; dry-run/apply and export SVG. Verify a regenerated 90 degree angle, never stored point witnesses.

In {document}, On the radial drawing, remove dim:radius and add dim:radius_extended on sheet:a4, view:front, edge ref ref:edge:circle, kind radius, leader direction [1, 1], extension 20 mm. Keep the diameter dimension and source geometry. Apply through DesignPatch, regenerate, and export an SVG.

In {document}, replace view:front with a new section view view:section_updated on sheet:a4. Preserve its part model reference, front projection, scale 0.5 and origin [0.05,0.05]. Move the section plane to z = 4 mm, normal [0,0,1], with hatch_spacing_m = 0.003. Use remove_drawing_view and add_drawing_view through DesignPatch, dry-run/apply, regenerate and export SVG. Verify fresh material area 0.0044 m², two loops and eight edges; never store contour caches.

In {document}, replace view:detail with view:detail_updated. Keep its model reference, parent view:front, front projection, region_min_m [0.06,0.04], region_max_m [0.09,0.07], and origin [0.15,0.10]. Set explicit magnification to 3 and child scale to 1.5 (parent scale stays 0.5). Use remove_drawing_view and add_drawing_view through DesignPatch; dry-run/apply, regenerate and export SVG. Verify two clipped edges and fresh scale/magnification evidence. Never author segment caches.

In {document}, update sheet:a4 title block revision to B and title to Inspection plate revision B, preserving every other title field, sheet, view and model. Use set_title_block through DesignPatch, dry-run/apply, regenerate and export SVG. Do not infer timestamps or other metadata and do not modify geometry.

In {document}, change only sheet:a4 title-block revision to B using set_title_block through DesignPatch, preserving all other metadata, geometry and the landscape sheet. Dry-run/apply, regenerate, then export every sheet to {document}.pdf. Verify two vector pages with A4 portrait and landscape physical sizes; do not infer timestamps or replace glyphs.

In {document}, change only sheet:a4 title-block revision to B using set_title_block through DesignPatch, preserving all other metadata and geometry. Dry-run/apply, regenerate, then export {document}.dxf. Verify a single A4 sheet, millimetre units and the 40 by 30 mm paper-space plate at 1:2 scale. Do not infer timestamps or modify geometry.

In {document}, add one fixed instance:extra of existing component:sub at translation [1.2,0,0] metres with identity rotation, preserving all existing parts, instances and the patterned child assembly. Use DesignPatch, verified dry-run/apply and regenerate. Query bom_document and write {document}.bom.json. Verify four top-level instances, one leaf-source row with ten plates (3*3+1), and complete nested regeneration. Do not merge copied source files or infer material/cost metadata.

In {document}, inspect {root}/examples/import/plate_outline.dxf, then import only OUTLINE as new sketch:dxf_copy / feature:sketch_dxf_copy through import_dxf. Preserve the existing extrusion, sketch and geometry. Verify dry-run first, apply with returned history and regenerate. The imported outline is 80 by 60 mm in SI coordinates; do not import LABELS text or rescale from destination display units.

In {document}, dry-run import {root}/examples/import/closed_plate_mm.stl through import_stl with source_unit mm and feature_id feature:stl_plate, then apply with history. Preserve the existing graph and source bytes. Regenerate and verify the imported closed plate is 80 by 60 by 6 mm, volume 28800 mm^3. Do not infer units or disguise STL as STEP.

In {document}, use a dry-run then verified DesignPatch to set ent:guide_line in sketch:base to construction false. Use the explicit set_sketch_construction operation, preserving every entity ID, point, constraint, parameter and consumer. Keep ent:guide_circle construction true. The open guide is not a solid boundary; regenerate and verify the 80 by 60 by 6 mm plate still has volume 28800 mm^3. Do not remove and recreate geometry or rebind profile:outer.

In {document}, plan_curve_edit to extend the end of ent:guide_line in sketch:base to cutter ent:e1, using new point ent:extended_end. Inspect the returned revision-guarded patch and solved-point expected effect, dry-run, then apply through verified patch_apply with history. Keep construction true, preserve old endpoints ent:guide_b and ent:edited_end and all constraints/parameters. The new guide endpoint is (80,30) mm; regenerate the unchanged 80 by 60 by 6 mm plate, volume 28800 mm^3. Do not move shared old points or remove the expected effect.

In {document}, use plan_offset to copy sketch:base ordered edges ent:e0, ent:e1, ent:e2, ent:e3 outward 3 mm with association independent_copy and join mitre_tangent into sketch:offset. Supply curve IDs ent:offset_curve_0 through ent:offset_curve_3 and point IDs ent:offset_point_0 through ent:offset_point_3. Preserve the source sketch and constraints. Inspect the returned DesignPatch, explicitly append feature:offset_sketch using sketch:offset and feature:offset_body as a 6 mm new-body extrusion of sketch:offset/profile:outer. Dry-run and apply with verified patch/history, then regenerate. The new body is 86 by 66 by 6 mm, volume 34056 mm3. Do not claim persistent association.

In {document}, change named parameter major_radius from 30 mm to 40 mm, preserving minor_radius 20 mm, thickness 6 mm and axis_angle_rad 30 degrees. Keep ent:ellipse in sketch:ellipse an analytic ellipse with source expressions major_radius, minor_radius, axis_angle_rad and centre ent:center; do not replace expressions with cached coordinates or approximate the curve with a polygon. Dry-run then apply a verified DesignPatch with history and regenerate. The exact volume is pi*40*20*6 = 15079.64474 mm3. Preserve the centre point at (0,0) mm.

In {document}, change the source circle radius parameter radius from 30 mm to 40 mm. Preserve feature:projection as a graph-owned projected_sketch bound to feature:source_sketch / ent:source_circle, destination sketch:projection, ent:projected_curve and ent:projected_center. Preserve the 30-degree target plane and 6 mm extrusion. Do not add the generated sketch or derived coordinates to authored sketches. Use inspect_projected_sketch to verify new semiaxes 40 mm and 40*cos(30) mm, dry-run/apply a verified DesignPatch with history, regenerate and inspect again. Exact volume is pi*40^2*cos(30)*6 mm3.

Open the supplied arm assembly at {document}. Through DesignPatch set view:exploded upper-arm offset to [0.15, 0, 0] metres, preserve every other offset, view name, instance placement, mate and joint. Dry-run and apply. Preview view:exploded with preview_document. Do not move mechanical placements.

Open the supplied coupled arm at {document}. Through verified DesignPatch set coupling:gear ratio to -0.25, preserving driver joint:shoulder and follower joint:elbow. Preserve all authored placements, mates, physical joint motion and other source data. Dry-run and apply. Use inspect_joint_pose with joint:shoulder=90deg; the derived elbow must be -22.5deg. Do not edit follower placement to approximate the result.

In {document}, change named control-coordinate parameter a from 40 mm to 60 mm. Preserve b=40 mm and the 6 mm normal extrusion. Keep ent:cubic a closed non-rational cubic_bezier with ordered control_points [ent:p0, ent:p1, ent:p2, ent:p0] in sketch:cubic. Preserve ent:p1.x expression a and ent:p2.y expression b, point IDs and source constraints. Dry-run and apply a verified DesignPatch with history, then regenerate. Analytic volume 3*60*40*6/20 = 2160 mm3; do not replace the curve with a polygon, edit knots/weights or serialize solved controls.

In {document}, use list_features, plan_feature_edit and apply_feature_edit for the four operations in examples/agent/feature_tree_edit.json: create feature:second as a NewBody distance extrusion of feature:cubic_sketch/profile:bezier:ent:cubic with 12 mm, edit its length_expr to 10 mm, move it before feature:cubic_body, then suppress feature:cubic_body. Query the current revision for each operation, preview before applying, and pass returned history unchanged. Preserve the authored cubic/parameter source. Regenerate; analytic volume is 2400 mm3. Do not use polygon replacement or direct source writes.

In {document}, add the declared face ref ref:face:ellipse_top with created_by feature:ellipse_body and role top using the verified semantic_ref_patch in examples/agent/semantic_selection_edit.json. Read inspect_selection_frame (or pick_document) for its actual source/scene revision and declared binding. Use plan_selection_edit and apply_selection_edit to change that selected extrusion length_expr to 10 mm, preserving sketch:ellipse, ent:ellipse, the profile reference and all original named parameters. Do not bind a mutation from inferred feature names/roles, bypass the selection tools, or edit generated coordinates. Preserve major_radius 30 mm, minor_radius 20 mm, axis_angle_rad 30 degrees and thickness parameter 6 mm; only the feature expression is changed. Regenerate; exact volume pi*30*20*10 = 18849.555922 mm3.

In {document}, use inspect_sketches then plan_sketch_edit and apply_sketch_edit to edit authored sketch:ellipse / ent:ellipse. Keep centre ent:center, change major_radius source expression to 40 mm, minor_radius to 15 mm, axis_angle to 0 deg. Preserve all original parameters, point coordinates, feature IDs and profile binding. Do not edit generated coordinates or bypass the shared sketch commands. Regenerate; exact volume pi*40*15*6 = 11309.733553 mm3. See examples/agent/interactive_sketch_edit.json.

In {document}, follow examples/agent/editing_tutorial.json. Use inspect_sketches, plan_sketch_edit and apply_sketch_edit to change sketch:ellipse / ent:ellipse to major_radius 40 mm, minor_radius 15 mm, axis_angle 0 deg, keeping centre ent:center. Then use list_features, plan_feature_edit and apply_feature_edit to change feature:ellipse_body length_expr to 10 mm. Preserve all named parameters, original points, source IDs and sketch:ellipse/profile:outer. Review must not write; stale or unitless edits must refuse. Regenerate and independently verify dimensions 80x30x10 mm and volume pi*40*15*10 = 18849.555922 mm3. Do not invent MCP history tools; Undo/Redo is on Agent API or Tauri.

The parent assembly {document} contains two copies of the same hinge child. Inspect child ownership and independent joints using inspect_articulation_source. Reset only instance:left joint:hinge from 90 deg to 0 deg using set_instance_articulation with the inspected child revision. Keep instance:right and both authored placements unchanged. Do not modify any child files. Dry-run, review, apply and regenerate the parent; report the four posed leaves.

The assembly {document} has two copies of one child mechanism and a fixed parent target connector. Inspect child joint/connector ownership and revision. Change only instance:left mate:parent_context relation to a signed distance of 0 mm. Keep positions empty, retain exact structured moving/target references, and do not modify any child or the right copy. Dry-run, review and apply through set_instance_articulation, regenerate, and report all five physical leaves and the bound context DOF.

The assembly {document} has two copies of one child mechanism and a fixed parent target connector. Inspect child joint/connector ownership and revision. Change only instance:left mate:parent_context relation to a signed angle of 90 deg with turns 0. Keep positions empty, retain exact structured moving/target references, and do not modify any child or the right copy. Dry-run, review and apply through set_instance_articulation, regenerate, and report all five physical leaves and the bound context DOF.

Change only the seat_depth parameter in {document} from 4 mm to 6 mm. Preserve the explicit seated_standard_hole / counterbore source, ISO273 M6 normal standard, 6.6 mm bore, 11 mm seat diameter, 10 mm bore depth, original stock/circle sketches, owned entry reference and feature order. Review then apply through DesignPatch and verify fresh regeneration and stepped removal volume. Do not replace the seat with a plain hole.

Change only seat_angle_rad in {document} from 90 deg to 60 deg. Preserve the explicit seated_standard_hole / countersink source, ISO273 M6 normal standard, 6.6 mm bore, 12 mm seat diameter, 10 mm bore depth, original stock/circle sketches, owned entry reference and feature order. Review then apply through DesignPatch, verify fresh native regeneration and the exact frustum/bore union volume. Do not substitute a counterbore or a plain hole.

Change only draft_angle_rad in {document} from 7 deg to -5 deg. Preserve the explicit cylindrical_draft source, original exact-circle Distance/NewBody stock, 20 mm radius, 30 mm height, owned full cylindrical side reference, 15 mm neutral plane and feature order. Review then apply through DesignPatch; verify fresh native regeneration and the radial slice integral. Do not substitute planar draft or change the angle sign.

Change only rib_height in {document} from 20 mm to 12 mm. Preserve the explicit tapered_rib source, square ends, original 40x30x10 mm rectangle Distance/NewBody stock, complete construction centreline from (5,15) to (35,15) mm on its end, owned extrusion_end reference, 4 mm base thickness and 2.862405226111748 deg angle. Review then apply through DesignPatch and verify fresh native union volume 13224 mm³. Do not substitute a constant-width rib or change source sketches/order.

Change only the nominal M6x1 basic flat-root external thread in {document} from right to left hand using replace_feature_definition through reviewed DesignPatch. Preserve representation nominal_metric_basic_flat_root, size m6, 8 whole pitches, square ends, original exact-circle Distance/NewBody stock (6 mm diameter, 8 mm height), authored phase frame, owned full side and feature order. Verify fresh native regeneration. Volume alone cannot distinguish the requested hand; do not substitute cosmetic, cylinder or generic helix geometry.

Change only the faceted circular fillet in {document} maximum_radius from 1.5 mm to 1 mm using reviewed replace_feature_definition through DesignPatch. Preserve minimum 0.5 mm, representation grid_faceted_periodic_cosine, verification canonical_grid_with_numerical_backend_checks, all explicit quality budgets, original exact-circle 10 mm radius / 20 mm Distance NewBody cylinder, positive authored X phase and owned complete extrusion_end Edge. Verify fresh native regeneration and physical export. This approximation rebuilds all supports as facets; do not claim exact G1 or substitute a constant fillet, cylinder or straight edge. Scalar volume alone cannot prove phase.

In {document}, use inspect_sketch_creation then plan_sketch_create/apply_sketch_create with the current document_id/revision to create sketch:new_1, owner feature:sketch_new_1, name New manufacturing sketch, on explicit global XZ. Review before applying and retain returned opaque history. Then use the shared sketch edit tools to create ent:new_center at explicit 0 mm/0 mm and ent:new_ellipse centered there with major_radius 20 mm, minor_radius 10 mm, axis_angle 0 deg. Use list_features and reviewed feature-edit tools to extrude the newly created owner/profile into feature:new_body as a 6 mm NewBody. Preserve every original parameter, sketch, semantic reference and feature. Verify native volume 1200*pi mm3 and fresh SI STL absolute bounds x[-20,20], y[-6,0], z[-10,10] mm; volume alone cannot prove the workplane. Do not write source directly. See examples/agent/create_global_sketch.json.

In {document}, Inspect admitted datum planes and create a new named sketch on feature:datum using the typed sketch creation tools. Keep its authored datum association. Create ent:new_center at local 0 mm, 0 mm and an ellipse ent:new_ellipse with semiaxes 20 mm / 10 mm and angle 0 deg through the typed sketch editor. Extrude it as a 6 mm new body feature:new_datum_body. Set param:offset to 15 mm through a DesignPatch, then edit the center to local 2 mm, -3 mm with current document identity/revision. Preserve all prior feature/sketch/semantic source and other parameters. Use sketch:new_1 and feature:sketch_new_1; verify source, world placement and Undo/Redo. Do not copy a custom frame over the datum reference.

In {document}, create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum through typed sketch creation. Then review and apply one typed sketch-edit batch with two operations: create point ent:circle_1_center at local 2.000 mm, -3.000 mm and create nonconstruction circle ent:circle_1 with that center and radius 5.000000 mm. This is the same source intent as the native center/radius pointer gesture; do not claim an MCP mouse gesture. Extrude the circle as a 6 mm new body feature:pointer_body. Preserve authored datum association, all prior source and parameters. Use current document identity/revision, verify the physical placement, and do not add dummy parameters.

In {document}, create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum using typed sketch creation. Review and apply one rectangle sketch form with id ent:rectangle_1, opposite corners x1=22.000 mm, y1=7.000 mm, x2=2.000 mm, y2=-3.000 mm, construction=false. The shared backend must expand this to four authored points and four authored lines in one atomic patch; do not create a stored Rectangle helper, dummy parameters or inferred constraints. Extrude its admitted closed profile as feature:pointer_body, 6 mm new body. Preserve all prior source, parameters and datum dependency. MCP supplies equivalent typed intent; native GUI evidence separately exercises the opposite-corner gesture. Verify fresh physical placement, centroid and volume.

In {document}, follow examples/agent/physical_arc_sector.json. Create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum through typed creation. Use current revision and patch_dry_run/patch_apply (verify=true) to author the six Point/Arc/Line entities exactly as shown: centre (2,-3) mm, radius 10 mm, CCW angles 0 deg to 90 deg, shared start/end points and two radial lines. Preserve all prior source/parameters and datum dependency. Create a 6 mm NewBody feature:sector_body from its admitted closed profile. Verify fresh native SI STL absolute bounds, centroid, oriented closure and analytic volume 150*pi mm3. A full radius-5 circle has the same volume but is the wrong shape. Do not replace the exact arc with a polygon or claim an MCP pointer gesture.

In {document}, follow examples/agent/create_pointer_arc.json through typed sketch creation and plan_sketch_edit/apply_sketch_edit. Create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum. Use the exact constant centre/start/end-direction strings shown, clockwise=false, close_sector=true, construction=false. The direction click is (2,17) mm; preserve radius 10 mm, projecting the endpoint to (2,7) mm. Preserve prior source and datum dependency. Create 6 mm NewBody feature:pointer_body. Independently verify the selected 90 degree CCW minor sector, volume 150*pi mm3, exact source and fresh native SI placement/centroid/closure. Do not guess the shortest arc or replace it with a polygon. MCP expresses typed intent, not mouse events.

In {document}, follow examples/agent/create_pointer_arc.json through typed sketch creation and plan_sketch_edit/apply_sketch_edit. Create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum. Use the exact constant centre/start/end-direction strings shown, clockwise=true, close_sector=true, construction=false. The direction click is (2,17) mm; preserve radius 10 mm, projecting the endpoint to (2,7) mm. Preserve prior source and datum dependency. Create 6 mm NewBody feature:pointer_body. Independently verify the selected 270 degree CW major sector, volume 450*pi mm3, exact source and fresh native SI placement/centroid/closure. Do not guess the shortest arc or replace it with a polygon. MCP expresses typed intent, not mouse events.

In {document}, follow examples/agent/create_pointer_ellipse.json through typed sketch creation and plan_sketch_edit/apply_sketch_edit. Create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum. Use operation ellipse_axes with the exact constant centre (2,-3) mm, major endpoint (26,15) mm and point ON ellipse (14,21) mm, construction=false. Backend derives major radius 30 mm, minor 20 mm and the major direction (.8,.6); perpendicular projection of the third point is only 12 mm and is wrong. Preserve prior source, parameters and datum dependency. Extrude 6 mm NewBody feature:pointer_body. Verify intended source and fresh SI output: volume 3600*pi mm3, absolute bounds, COM, oriented closure and major/minor directional supports. A sign-reflected ellipse can have identical volume, COM and axis-aligned bounds. No helper, schema, dummy parameters or inferred constraints. MCP expresses typed intent, not mouse events.

In {document}, follow examples/agent/constrain_selected_circle.json. Create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum. Author exactly the two source points A=(2,-3) mm and B=(26,15) mm, construction guide ent:guide, and ordinary circle ent:disc with source radius 5 mm. Extrude a 6 mm NewBody feature:disc_body. Through typed plan_sketch_edit/apply_sketch_edit add con:control_1 Horizontal on ent:guide, con:control_2 point-to-point Distance 20 mm on A/B, and con:control_3 Radius 10 mm on ent:disc. Preserve original source expressions, prior source and datum dependency. Inspect actual backend solved B=(22,-3) mm, radius 10 mm, remaining DOF 0. Independently grade exact constraint source plus fresh native SI STL volume 600*pi mm3, bounds, centroid and oriented closure. Direct radius editing alone produces the same volume but fails the intended design. No helper geometry/schema or frontend solver. MCP expresses typed intent, not mouse events.

In {document}, follow examples/agent/toggle_selected_construction.json through typed sketch create/plan/apply. Create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum. Author exactly the example primitives with original expressions and construction flags. Change only ent:disc construction=false, then extrude a 6 mm NewBody feature:disc_body of profile:circle:ent:disc. Change only ent:ellipse construction=false and ent:a construction=true; keep ent:guide construction=true and all coordinates, radius/axes expressions, constraints, IDs, prior source and dependencies. Inspect actual backend profile_effect and construction_targets. A consumed circle must refuse construction=true without changing source/history. Independently grade exact flags/source and fresh native SI solid volume 600*pi mm3, absolute bounds/centroid/oriented closure. A wrong unconsumed ellipse flag or rewriting '1 cm' as '10 mm' produces the same solid but fails the intended design. No helper geometry/schema or frontend profile solver. MCP expresses typed intent, not mouse events.

In {document}, follow examples/agent/resolve_sketch_source_lengths.json. Add exactly its origin_x/origin_y/diameter length parameters through DesignPatch. Create sketch:new_1 owned by feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum. Plan/apply exactly its authored primitives; inspect resolved ordinary point coordinates and 10 mm circle radius while preserving source arithmetic. Extrude 6 mm NewBody feature:disc_body of profile:circle:ent:disc. Review/apply parameter_radius preserving exact expression 'diameter / 4 + 5 mm'. Keep all prior source, parameters, datum dependency and empty constraints. Read-only plan_curve_edit with explicit branch 1 of ent:guide against ent:disc yields (10,3) mm. Independently grade exact source plus fresh native SI STL: 600*pi mm3, bounds (-8,-13,5)..(12,7,11) mm, COM (2,-3,8) mm and oriented closure. Equivalent literal radius or unconsumed point source rewrite fails the intent. Reject wrong units and preserve canonical history/refusal. No new geometry, schema or UI control.

In {document}, follow examples/agent/trim_selected_guide.json exactly. Add its origin_x, origin_y, diameter parameters; create sketch:new_1 / feature:sketch_new_1 on existing feature:datum; author its source primitives and two constraints, then extrude feature:disc_body of profile:circle:ent:disc by 6 mm. Use inspect_sketch_curve_edit with current identity/revision, ent:guide target, ent:disc cutter, trim/end. Explicitly choose branch 1 (10,3) mm and remove only con:guide_length via a sole typed curve_edit with new_point_id ent:trim_end_1. Retained 40 mm length must refuse because it moves the solved endpoint. Preserve con:guide_horizontal, original ent:right, exact expressions, flags, owners, datum, prior source, and complete opaque history. Review/apply is atomic; no implicit branch or removal. Grade exact intended source and fresh native SI STL volume 600*pi mm3, bounds (-8,-13,5)..(12,7,11) mm, COM (2,-3,8) mm, and oriented closure. Another branch or rewriting an unconsumed old endpoint has the same body but fails the design. No new geometry, schema, solver or frontend intersection math.
